cases.title: Source missing/stale, scope expiry and forced transaction rollback
cases.reason: No public entry deletes/changes the source message or expires the project grant; transaction-failure injection is not exposed. These remain NOT_TESTED.
limitations: Controlled fixture executor with real SQLite; no vendor model and no native task.
Owner: main/C. Deleting a source message, expiring a grant mid-flight and injecting a commit failure need test-only seams that are not public.
The current source remains current and the transaction is proven atomic by the receipt/event/catalog checks; absence of a fault API is not evidence of rollback.

cases.title: Proposal confirmation and context window are explicit, transactional and revocable
cases.reason: NOT_TESTED: main publishes no proposal confirm/reject/replay or context preview endpoint. Required inputs: proposal id/revision, source message and digest, current grant/scope/profile/contract, decision to confirm, plus context preview with project/conversation/work binding, window and invalidity. Planned negatives: unconfirmed means no execution; a failed original command leaves no half-confirmed state; an unknown response reuses the same command id; source/actor/grant/scope/profile/version drift is refused; revoke invalidates later context; cross-project isolation and reopen.
limitations: Owner: main (HTTP/composition) + C (rules). No proposal/context entry is published in this main yet.
